# ReviewGuard - Fake Review Detector

Share

Add to Chrome

## Overview

Detects fake and manipulated reviews on Amazon, Google Maps, and TripAdvisor with an instant trust score.

ReviewGuard detects fake and manipulated reviews instantly — right inside your browser. Every review gets a badge: Suspicious Review / Uncertain / Looks Genuine. WHAT IT DETECTS: • Fake review patterns (generic text, suspicious phrases, no specifics) • Rating manipulation (unusual 1-star or 5-star concentration) • Review bombing attacks • Text similarity between reviews (copy-paste fakes) • Unverified purchases WORKS ON: • Amazon (free) • Google Maps (Pro) • TripAdvisor (Pro) HOW TO USE: Install the extension, navigate to any product or business page with reviews, and ReviewGuard analyzes them automatically. Click the shield icon for the full trust score report. Upgrade to Pro at reviewguard.gumroad.com for $1.99/month to unlock Google Maps, TripAdvisor, and full signals breakdown.
